title: Chapter 315: Attacking The Evil God Camp Coalition
content:
Chapter 315: Attacking The Evil God Camp Coalition

After receiving the emergency intelligence reported by Naga, the Naga tribe leaders immediately notified Naga and asked her to contact the Zerg and inform the Zerg of some restrictions on the actions of the powerful.

Naga immediately found host No. 3 and handed the information obtained from the leaders to host No. 3.

"No. 3, the power of the powerful cannot be used at will, you must pay attention!"

Naga reminded solemnly.

"Thank the elders of the tribe for reminding us, we know our limits!"

Google search TWKAN

Host No. 3 passed some of the information about the powerful provided by the Naga tribe to Wu Qing.

The information recorded in the information is not much different from Wu Qing's guess. Frequent use of the power of the powerful, even if it helps the world to expel foreign enemies, will also be rejected by the world.

This kind of world's rejection is a huge threat to the powerful individuals and the races behind them.

This is also the reason why each major tribe has a powerful person sitting in the seat, but almost never directly helps the race develop. If the powerful directly takes action in this world, it will be a hindrance.

The Naga tribe also mentioned vaguely that the powerful have their own battlefields, but they are not in this world.

These secrets require the Zerg to obtain the status of a great tribe before they are qualified to know, so Wu Qing did not think too much about it.

…

In the next two days, every night, the Zerg extermination troops will fight with the weird all night long, and kill one or two eight-star weirds every night.

During these two days, under the pressure of the Zerg army's attack, the two great tribes of the evil god camp, the demon tribe and the bear goblin tribe, finally reached an agreement and united.

The alien race, who had already noticed the extreme harm of the Zerg, also intervened.

Under the unified coordination of the super tribe of the evil god camp, the super tribe of the evil god camp, plus two tribes and many other races, formed a super joint army.

This super joint army, with a giant city as the center, expanded into a super battlefield, and a batch of large space transmission channels directly leading to the tribes of each tribe were built.

A large number of elite troops from various races gathered, and batches of seven-star strongmen from various races also arrived one after another.

The various races of the evil god camp could not find targeted arms to deal with the several ultimate arms of the Zerg army, and various powerful war machines could not gain an advantage.

The aliens, demons and bear goblins had a very detailed understanding of the Zerg army through the performance of the Zerg army on various battlefields, and were very familiar with the characteristics of each Zerg army.

After research, it was found that other methods were not feasible except for using stronger seven-star arms and various rare and incomparable strange objects and divine objects.

There is no impenetrable wall in the world, not to mention that the evil god camp has deeply infiltrated the local camp, and the evil god camp has long known that the Zerg has not yet obtained the status of a major clan.

Now that the Zerg has gone deep into the sphere of influence of the evil god camp alone, the demons and bear goblins want to violate the agreement and directly send strong men to participate in the war to catch the Zerg off guard.

The alien race only appeared as a super tribe to coordinate, and the actual troops sent were not many. This side was still the home field of the demons and bear goblins.

The Zerg host soon discovered the location where the evil god camp army assembled on a large scale. The Zerg army deployed a large number of troops around the battlefield prepared by the evil god camp army.

Through the Zerg host, Wu Qing finally saw the true appearance of the Lingshen Green Department's direct troops, which had fought once before.

From Wu Qing's perspective, this is a unit with the same excellent equipment as the elite troops of the alien race, but the soldiers have been replaced by taller and stronger bear goblins instead of human beings.

The reason why they are so famous is mainly because of the spirit god. The spirit god specially built six troops with different colors of clothing under his command. The bear goblins have green skin and green equipment. They follow the will of the spirit god and fight on many battlefields, so they are easy to remember.

The direct troops of the spirit god's green department, with the name of the spirit god, are certainly not in vain, and their combat power is very strong.

Their one-star basic troops are as powerful as the two-star troops of ordinary armies, among which the proportion of high-star troops is very high, and there are many five-star troops.

The troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department are the real core elite troops of the bear goblin tribe.

Among the army of the evil god camp assembled this time, the troops directly under the Spirit God Green Department are the most conspicuous one, with a strength of nearly 10 million.

The core elite troops of the demon tribe are all composed of great demons. Tens of millions of great demons of various star strengths that can fly gather together, which looks very shocking.

The super tribe of the evil god camp, the alien race, has a total strength of less than 10 million, and most of them are subordinate races.

The alien race can lead this upcoming war, in addition to their status as a super tribe, it is also related to the fact that they have sent a group of powerful seven-star strongmen.

In the public battlefield of the southern theater, many large tribes in the local camp were watching, and the strong men of the alien race did not dare to take action easily. Since the demons and bear goblins decided to use strong men to deal with the Zerg, the alien race would of course give full support and sent a large team of strong men.

The Zerg found the gathering place of the evil god camp army, and the six-star Zerg host flew over, hiding in the sky, monitoring the situation around the clock.

Wu Qing found that the seven-star strong men of the evil god camp soon exceeded a thousand, and there was a trend of continued increase. The intention of the strong men to take action was already very obvious.

If the strong men of the evil god camp did not take action, there would be no chance of winning if the assembled army fought the Zerg normally.

Twenty-one Zerg air forces are fighting in the territory of the evil god camp. There are twenty-one seven-star Zerg queens and seven-star Zerg scorpions that can kill eight-star enemies, which can kill forty-two eight-star enemies instantly.

There are a total of 420 six-star Zerg queens and six-star Zerg scorpions, which can kill 420 seven-star enemies at the same time.

Among them, 210 six-star Zerg scorpions have the ability to kill seven-star enemies continuously, but they need a little time buffer between two attacks, which may bring adverse consequences in a fierce battlefield.

Therefore, Wu Qing formed a team consisting of 500 six-star Zerg queens and 500 six-star Zerg scorpions, specifically to deal with the strong men of the evil god camp.

In normal combat, this six-star team is not wasted and can effectively assist other arms in combat.

All branches of the Zerg were ready. Twenty-one Zerg air forces gathered together, and together with the newly built six-star team, they led a large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that continued to arrive, and rushed to the gathering place of the evil god camp army.

As long as the Zerg found a large-scale enemy, Wu Qing didn't want to delay for a moment. He had to fight as soon as possible to make the Zerg a large tribe as soon as possible.

Tens of millions of Zerg air forces, countless Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions launched an attack on the evil god camp army that was still gathering.

On the plain where the edge could not be seen at a glance, there stood a huge city. Within hundreds of kilometers around the city, there were all the evil god army garrisons with fortifications built.

After summarizing the characteristics of the Zerg army, the three major races of the evil god camp thought of building fortifications to defend against the Zerg army's extremely powerful ultra-long-range attacks.

There are fortifications dug into the ground and covered with shields everywhere. When facing the super-long-range attacks of the Zerg, you can enter the fortifications nearby to avoid them and reduce casualties.

When you need to go out to fight, these fortifications are covered with a thick and flat protective layer, which does not affect the army's battle formation.

When Wu Qinggang saw the construction of fortifications by the evil god camp, he was very surprised. In a world where cold arms and phalanxes fight, he actually saw fortifications for hot weapons.

The final effect of this tactic is still unknown, but it will definitely reduce the casualties of the evil god camp army to a certain extent.

"Bang bang bang...!"

The five-star Zerg air guards with the longest range opened fire first.

210,000 five-star Zerg air guards, based on the battlefield intelligence provided by the Zerg host, launched a covering attack on the siege equipment, high-star arms, magic and long-range arms in the evil god camp army.

"Boom boom...!"

Under the attack of the five-star Zerg air guards, the evil god camp army quickly hid in the fortifications around them.

The defensive capabilities of the various fortifications built by the evil god camp should be good for defending ordinary long-range attacks, but under the powerful attack of the five-star Zerg Sky Guards, the defensive effect of those simple fortifications is very limited.

Two hundred and ten thousand five-star Zerg Sky Guards opened up an extremely long battle line, and under the protection of the five-star Zerg Devourers and tens of millions of Zerg Dragons of the same strength, they continuously launched attacks.

On the positions of the evil god camp army, the Zerg Sky Guards' coverage attack mode can destroy the targets that can be destroyed directly, and the targets that cannot be hit will switch to single-point attack mode to pull out those strong defensive nails one by one.

The Zerg Sky Guards' attacks not only hit extremely far, but also hit extremely accurately. Many important targets in the evil god camp army were destroyed.

The Zerg Sky Guards did not care about the evil god camp troops hiding in the fortifications, but only attacked various important targets exposed outside, from near to far, all the way.

The Zerg army continued to advance. When the two sides were close to a certain extent, the six-star Zerg scorpions took action. They used black bees to create a large number of black fogs composed of micro-bugs, which enveloped the Zerg air force and some ground forces, adding a strong layer of defense to the Zerg combat forces.

The black fog spread rapidly, covering the main combat forces of the Zerg army. Those long-range soldiers of the evil god camp army that needed to lock on to the target for attack all lost their targets and could only attack blindly.

The Zerg army advanced to the range of the five-star Zerg Devourer. Regardless of whether there were enemies or not, they sprayed terrible mucus on the positions of the evil god camp army in turn.

A large amount of mucus fell on the positions of the evil god camp army. Those soldiers of the evil god camp army who were not directly attacked, even if they were hiding in fortifications, were infected by the pervasive special spores, and their abilities in all aspects were greatly weakened.
